description: Proposed core-matrix model list (pre-registration section 4). Ids are Inspect model ids. Each was verified in the provider's models endpoint and smoke-checked with one tiny Inspect generate call (prompt 'Reply with the single word: ok', max_tokens 64).

models.notes: Only current Pro text model in the Gemini models API; still a preview id. A custom-tools variant (gemini-3.1-pro-preview-customtools) also exists; the plain id is proposed.

smoke.stop_reason: max_tokens (59 of 64 tokens were thinking; answer still returned)

models.notes: Inspect's native grok provider needs the xai-sdk package; added to pyproject.toml (uv add xai-sdk) on 2026-10-03. The OpenAI-compatible route openai-api/xai/grok-4.7 (XAI_BASE_URL=https://api.x.ai/v1) also passed and needs no extra dependency.

GA DeepSeek V4 Pro, open weights, tools supported. Pinned dated id rather than the ~deepseek/deepseek-pro-latest alias. Alternatives seen on OpenRouter: moonshotai/kimi-k3, z-ai/glm-5.3, qwen/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b. Recommend pinning the provider (-M provider=...) so cost is exact; see prereg/model-prices.json.
